# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_PREMIUM_STOP_60PCT

**Filed:** 2026-07-12  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Loosening the premium stop from -50% to -60% will allow losing trades more room to recover, reducing average loss magnitude and potentially increasing win rate. However, it may also increase catastrophic losses on truly adverse moves, increasing tail risk. Net effect on edge_capture is uncertain without OOS validation.

## Mechanism

Change the premium stop parameter for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON in Safe account from `-0.50` to `-0.60`. Chart stop (primary invalidation) and chandelier profit-lock remain unchanged. Position sizing and all other parameters (TP1, runner, etc.) stay identical to baseline.
